name: ESP32-DevKitC V4 Development Board
description: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4 dev board (ESP32-WROOM-32E), 38-pin 2.54 headers at 25.4mm row spacing - drop it onto a carrier PCB with two 1x19 sockets. WROOM antenna overhangs the board edge by 6mm: keep that zone copper-free.
keywords: esp32 devkitc devboard wroom-32 espressif development
